observation.command: cd /workspace && nohup npm start > /tmp/devserver2.log 2>&1 & echo "pid=$!"; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 2; if curl -sf -o /tmp/qm.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/ 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; done; echo "---title---"; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/qm.html; echo "---bytes---"; wc -c /tmp/qm.html; echo "---port---"; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8080
